answer_1.quote: Paraphrase generation is an important task in Natural Language Processing (NLP) that has many applications in other down-stream tasks, such as text summarization, question answering, semantic parsing, and information retrieval.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates paraphrases by retrieving similar sentence pairs and applying fine-grained edits using Micro Edit Vectors (MEVs).

answer_2.quote: We compare different methods using BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR as the most common metrics for automatic evaluation of paraphrase generation methods.

answer_4.quote: we use human evaluation to assess the performance of our model qualitatively. We evaluate them in two scenarios. In the first scenario, we ask the human annotators to score the outputs individually based on the following two criteria: 1) Grammar and fluency, 2) Consistency and coherency.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators score outputs based on grammar and fluency, and consistency and coherency using a 5-scale rating. In a second scenario, they make one-on-one comparisons of generated paraphrase groups to judge which model produces better outputs.
